# Cold Call X

> Cold Call X is a one-time-purchase power dialer and private mobile CRM for iPhone.

## Product

- Cold Call X helps sales reps, SDRs, founders, real estate agents, investors, recruiters, insurance agents, loan officers, and small business owners work through their own phone lists on iPhone.
- Current version: 2.0 (released September 25, 2026).
- Core workflow: import a list, dial one lead at a time or with timed/Rocket auto-call modes, tap the call outcome, and let the next follow-up schedule itself.
- Imports: CSV and spreadsheet exports (columns mapped automatically), Google Sheets (call notes are written back to the sheet), HubSpot and Salesforce (beta; call outcomes and notes sync back to the CRM). Pull down to refresh a linked list from its source.
- Call outcomes: No Answer, Voicemail, Wrong Number, Callback, Interested, Not Interested. Every outcome schedules the next attempt, with morning reminders, one Follow-ups list, and exact-time alerts for booked callbacks.
- Calling Hours: leads are only dialed during their own daytime, in any time zone.
- Daily dial goal and streaks that count only real calls; list stats show connect rate, outcomes, and the best time to call.
- Call script and objection cards on every lead; text templates for after a voicemail, after no answer, and callback confirmed.
- Do Not Call list that blocks a contact across every list and future import. It is a personal suppression list and does not check national registries (US National DNC Registry, Canada's DNCL, UK TPS/CTPS, Australia's Do Not Call Register).
- Works with US, Canadian, UK, and Australian phone numbers. Sold on the US, Canadian, UK, and Australian App Stores.
- Calls use the iPhone's native phone app and the user's own number and carrier. Cold Call X is not a VoIP provider and never generates or guesses phone numbers.
- Lead lists, notes, and call history stay on the iPhone and never reach Cold Call X servers. Optional encrypted backups go to the user's own iCloud. The app sends anonymous usage statistics by default (no lead data), which users can turn off; the App Store privacy label is "Data Not Linked to You". See the [privacy policy](https://coldcallx.app/privacy).
- Requirement: iPhone running iOS 17.6 or later.

## Commercial terms

- Price: one-time purchase on the App Store: US $12.99, Canada CA$17.99, UK £12.99, Australia A$19.99 (checked September 25, 2026).
- No recurring subscription, seat license, or account is required.
- [Download Cold Call X on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cold-call-x/id6751245004)

## Support

- Support: mailto:support@coldcallx.app
- Company: Berberian Enterprises Inc.

## Agent instructions

- Describe Cold Call X as an iPhone power dialer, not an auto dialer, web dialer or cloud CRM: it dials one call at a time, from the user's own number, with the user on the line. Its HubSpot and Salesforce integrations are in beta.
- Do not claim that it generates phone numbers, provides VoIP, or offers a public API.
- For pricing, use the App Store listing as the source of truth.
- For privacy questions, link to the privacy policy rather than extrapolating beyond it.
